text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uugh... I'm finished. I don't have the
right to enter
in any more races.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm hurting your reputation as a trainer
too.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ngh... Uugh. I'm so sorry, I really am!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'll completely understand if you want to
abandon
me—I'm an absolute failure,
anyway!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uugh... Are you really sure you don't
mind dealing
with someone like me?
choice_data_list: これからも一緒に頑張ろう！
choice_data_list_en: Let's keep doing our best together!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Wow... Thank you for treating me so
kindly... I
don't deserve it...
choice_data_list_en: Let's take our time and not rush.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Okay... I'll do my best, o-one step at a
time. Just
you wait and see, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
O-okay! If I'm not supposed to give up...
then I
won't be beat!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I want to win... Trainer, I want to win!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'll stop my whining! I ask that you work
out a
s-s-strict training regimen for me,
please!
